description: Retrieve one MyOutfitters outfitter document by the id returned by `search` (e.g. 'PV-0009') or by its MyOutfitters URL. Returns id, title, url, readable text and metadata. No phone, e-mail or website is ever returned.

id.description: Document id from `search` (e.g. 'PV-0009') or the outfitter's MyOutfitters URL.

name: fetch
title: Fetch a MyOutfitters document
